results.question: 2025年每个月的GMV是多少
results.sql:
SELECT d.month AS 月, SUM(f.gross_amount) AS GMV
FROM fact_order f
JOIN dim_date d ON f.date_id = d.date_id
WHERE d.year = 2025 AND f.order_status != '已取消'
GROUP BY d.month
ORDER BY d.month;

results.question: 各渠道的有效订单数分别是多少
results.sql:
SELECT dc.channel_name AS 渠道, COUNT(DISTINCT fo.order_id) AS 有效订单数
FROM fact_order fo
JOIN dim_channel dc ON fo.channel_id = dc.channel_id
WHERE fo.order_status != '已取消'
GROUP BY dc.channel_name
